name: stage3d
title: Stage3d: the three.js tier
description: The lazy three.js tier (decision 0017): loadThree() imports three only when a live 3D drawing is about to be seen, and resolves null if it cannot; webglAvailable(), liteDevice() and watchVisible() choose and pause the tier; the pure core chooses live, 2D or still, reprojects a photo with a depth map so a moving camera gives true parallax, and fits it to any frame; and it puts words in z-space (decision 0029): a 3D object's silhouette becomes a shape for the type tier, and the lines the type tier lays are painted as textured quads in the object's own scene, the DOM spans staying the real words. Needs the npm package three at exactly 0.186.1.

budget.reason: Decision 0017: the tier is budgeted apart from the dependency-free layers. It was 10.0 KB (stage3d.js 4.3 KB, stage3d.core.js 5.8 KB, 12 KB declared); rung 5 of the text tier adds the words-in-z-space half, 17.0 KB of source with its comments, raised to 28 KB by the Sutradhar's leave: occlusion.core.js 4.8 KB (a silhouette becomes a shape for the type tier, a CSS shape-outside hug for the still; pure), occlusion.live.js 0.9 KB (a mesh's vertices through the camera), text.core.js 3.3 KB (line boxes, the span painter's style, the quad plan and the camera arithmetic; pure) and text.live.js 7.6 KB (one canvas texture per line in the pot's own scene, with the baseline asked of the engine, context-loss and late-font handling). The two live files load only on the live tier, by dynamic import. three itself (npmDependencies) is recorded per story as bundled.

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
